name: Meteor-Marked Shelf
introDiscord: Meteor-Marked Lobsters occupy every desirable piece of the shelf and enforce an extremely simple property law: if a lobster is standing on it, it belongs to the lobster.
introTwitch: Meteor-Marked Lobsters occupy every desirable piece of the shelf and enforce an extremely simple property law: if a lobster is standing on it, it belongs to the lobster.

meteor-marked-shelf-approach.prompt: Three shelf paths wind between suspiciously territorial crustaceans.

left.message: A cometglass seam lies just outside one lobster's property line.

right.message:
A Meteor-Marked Lobster plants both claws on the path.

Property dispute.

forward.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Local law: lobster owns rock. I appealed. Lobster denied appeal."
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic and respect local jurisprudence.

meteor-marked-shelf-depths.prompt: Three routes cross increasingly elaborate lobster territories.

left.message:
A lobster has constructed a border using pebbles.

You crossed it.

International incident.

right.message: A star-chart coffer sits inside an apparently abandoned territory.

forward.message:
A Berry rests beside Shizuki's legal document:

"I hereby claim this one tiny rock.

Signed, Shizuki.

COUNTERCLAIM: claw marks."

meteor-marked-shelf-threshold.prompt: Craterclaw Arena lies beyond three heavily defended shelf paths.

left.message: Shizuki's bottle is stored inside neutral territory.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the neutral-zone medicine untouched.

right.message:
A lobster raises both claws.

Negotiations have concluded.

forward.message:
"A meteor-iron reliquary rests beneath a disputed meteor fragment."

BOSS:

boss-antechamber.name: Craterclaw Arena
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every ordinary lobster retreats from the arena.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every ordinary lobster retreats from the arena.

A colossal claw strikes the center stone.

Use /yes to enter Craterclaw Arena or /no to respect the local ruler's extremely aggressive zoning policy.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every ordinary lobster retreats from the arena.

A colossal claw strikes the center stone.

Use !yes to enter Craterclaw Arena or !no to respect the local ruler's extremely aggressive zoning policy.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw across the property line.

boss.revealText:
An enormous armored lobster rises from the crater.

Impactclaw Tyrant reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Tyrant retreats.

The ordinary lobsters immediately begin redistributing territory.

Your tiny rock has already been annexed."
